exposure: Clinical audits based on objective criteria
Decision-support reminders of indications for caesareans via text messages
cohort: Patients who delivered by caesarean during a 6-month period in the year preceding the intervention and the 6 months following its end in 22 public hospitals equipped with a functional operating room in Burkina Faso
finding: The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of a multi-faceted intervention to reduce the rate of non-medically indicated caesareans in Burkina Faso.
